descr: Gemini 3.8 Flash vs DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-20260910: Gemini 3.8 Flash leads by 24 chat points.

sceglieA: Pick DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-20260910 if coding assistance is your priority. It outperforms Gemini 3.8 Flash in the WebDev (coding) category with a score of 1621 versus 1584. The model is suited for tasks that need stronger programming suggestions.
